title: Dynamic Settings & Catalogs (Catalog Items, Tabbed Settings UI, Center Branding)
assumptions: Catalog items code is immutable once created; only label, order_index, and is_active can be modified.
Settings resolution hierarchy: center-specific setting -> system-wide setting -> default fallback.
Center admins can override system settings marked as is_overridable=true for their center.
Super admin has global access; center_admin manages settings/catalogs for their own center.
The /settings page adapts its visible tabs dynamically based on caller role.
